title: TokenDance: Scaling Multi-Agent LLM Serving via Collective KV Cache Sharing
authors: Zhuohang Bian; Feiyang Wu; Chengrui Zhang; Hangcheng Dong; Yun Liang; Youwei Zhuo
affiliations: Peking University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: Synchronized All-Gather rounds in multi-agent LLM applications redistribute every agent's outputs into subsequent prompts, creating near-duplicate KV caches at different positions. Request-local prefix and position-independent caching repeat reuse analysis for every agent and retain a dense cache per request, limiting concurrent-agent capacity under a fixed GPU-memory budget.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM 應用的同步 All-Gather round 會將每個 agent 的輸出重新分發至後續 prompt，使不同位置產生近乎重複的 KV cache。request-local prefix caching 與 position-independent caching 會對每個 agent 重複執行重用分析，並為每個 request 保留一份 dense cache，因而在固定 GPU memory 預算下限制可並行的 agent 數量。

key_innovation.en: TokenDance raises the reuse unit from one request to an entire All-Gather round. Its KV Collector performs one batched RoPE and key-difference analysis for compatible agents, while Diff-Aware Storage represents sibling caches as sparse Mirrors of one Master and fuses diff restoration into the layerwise GPU-transfer path.
key_innovation.zh: TokenDance 將重用單位由單一 request 提升至整個 All-Gather round。其 KV Collector 對相容的 agent 統一執行一次 batched RoPE 與 key-difference analysis；Diff-Aware Storage 則以一份 Master 及其 sparse Mirror 表示同輪的 sibling cache，並將 diff restore 融合至逐層 GPU transfer path。

key_improvements.en: On GenerativeAgents and AgentSociety, TokenDance supports up to 2.7x more concurrent agents than vLLM with prefix caching under the latency SLO, compresses per-agent KV-cache storage by up to 17.5x, and accelerates prefill by up to 1.9x over per-request position-independent caching.
key_improvements.zh: 在 GenerativeAgents 與 AgentSociety 上，TokenDance 於 latency SLO 下可支援的並行 agent 數量最高為使用 prefix caching 之 vLLM 的 2.7x，per-agent KV cache storage 最高壓縮 17.5x，且相較 per-request position-independent caching 的 prefill 最高加速 1.9x。

reuse_metric.en: Master-Mirror storage compresses a recovered Mirror KV cache by 11.2x for Qwen2.5-7B and 17.5x for Qwen2.5-14B. The collective path produces the same recovered KV caches as per-request CacheBlend and introduces no additional accuracy degradation beyond that backend.
reuse_metric.zh: Master-Mirror storage 對 Qwen2.5-7B 與 Qwen2.5-14B 的 recovered Mirror KV cache 分別達到 11.2x 與 17.5x 壓縮。collective path 產生的 recovered KV cache 與 per-request CacheBlend 相同，未在該 backend 之外引入額外 accuracy degradation。
